core_obligations: Record the parenthetical: separability of either extension implies reducedness of the tensor product of the residue field with K (proof lines 310-311).

Combine the ground field change lemma with the dimension computation to see that the quotient of the local ring at y by the ideal generated by the maximal ideal at x has dimension zero (proof lines 312-314).
Use the reducedness hypothesis to conclude that this quotient is a field, so the containment of maximal ideals is an equality (proof lines 314-315).
proof_roadmap: Reduced plus zero dimensional gives a field (proof lines 314-315).
difficulty_reason: In the notation of the ground field change lemma, assuming X locally of finite type over k, equality of the dimensions of the two local rings and reducedness of the tensor product of the residue field at x with K, the lemma proves that the ideal generated by the maximal ideal of the local ring at x is already the maximal ideal of the local ring at y (statement lines 299-307). The proof combines the structure of the ground field change with the dimension computation to see that the quotient of the larger local ring by that ideal has dimension zero, and by hypothesis that quotient is reduced, so it is a field and the containment is an equality (proof lines 310-315). The claim is H2: two cited inputs plus the observation that a reduced zero dimensional ring is a field, which is exactly where the reducedness hypothesis is used.
